newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down on panic selling.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down on panic selling.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down as small investors, panicked by political uncertainty, created selling pressure while institutional investors kept to the sidelines, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index fell 39.98 points or 2.43 percent to 1,603.45 on turnover of 71.3 million taka. Of 118 traded issues 20 rose and 94 lost while four were unchanged.

"The market sentiment was depressed. Small investors were selling in a falling market," said one broker. Quasem Drycells lost 8.0 taka to 104, Apex Foods shed 332 to 3,091 and Beximco Pharma was down 6.0 to 216.
